s02C582.name: Chuck state 5: split or hop at Mario
summary: State 5 handler. Faces Mario. Timer [$1540] = 0: if Mario is within $50 pixels horizontally start a $40 frame countdown, else hop every 64 frames.
Countdown reaches 1: Bouncin' Chuck ($93) jumps toward Mario (state 6); any other Chuck splits: spawns two Chargin' Chucks ($91) that fly apart.
Also holds CODE_02C628 (starts the head turn timer [$15AC] = 8) as a tail.

s02C62E.name: Table: head pose by look-around step

s02C63B.name: Chuck state 0: look around for Mario
summary: State 0 handler. Every 16 timer frames checks whether Mario is within $28 pixels vertically; if so faces him, sets [$187B] and enters state 2.
Falls into CODE_02C668 when no Mario seen, which animates the head scan and turns the Chuck around when the timer ends.

s02C668.name: Chuck head scan and turn around
summary: Timer 0: flips direction and enters state 2 (pause). Otherwise every 4th frame steps head pose index [$1594] up and down 0..$0A and sets head pose [$151C].

s02C69F.name: Tables: Chuck walk speeds and poses

s02C6A7.name: Chuck state 1: walk and charge
summary: State 1 handler. Walks or charges at Mario. If Mario is within $30 pixels vertically and the Chuck faces him, sets timer and charge flag [$187B] = $20.
Timer 0: back to state 0 with a random $40-$7F timer. Charging uses faster speed ($18/$E8), plays a footstep sound every 8 frames, and animates poses $12/$13.
Quirk: the first lines are dead code, and ADDR_02C6B5 (play sound $24) is unreachable.

s02C73D.name: Tables: hurt poses and step durations

s02C74A.name: Chuck state 3: hurt after stomp
summary: Plays a 6-step hurt animation ([$1570] = step, pose from table, step time in [$1540]).
When it ends: Whistlin' Chuck ($94) goes to state $C; Diggin' Chuck ($46) becomes Chargin' Chuck ($91); others go to state 2 with timer $30, charge flag set, facing Mario.

s02C79D.name: Chuck: interact with Mario
summary: Skipped while contact cooldown [$1564] is non-zero. Touching with star power kills the Chuck (status 2, points).
Stomp (Mario well above): cooldown 5, bounce Mario, count stomps in [$1528]; 3rd stomp kills it, otherwise enters hurt state 3 and pushes Mario away.
Side contact: hurts Mario unless riding Yoshi.

s02C830.name: Table: head X offset by pose

s02C84A.name: Table: head Y offset by pose

s02C864.name: Table: head OAM slot offset by pose

ChuckHeadTiles.name: Chuck graphics: head tiles and routine
summary: Chuck GFX routine at CODE_02C81A: GetDrawInfo2, then head, body, arms/extra tiles and shovel; finishes with 5 tiles, sizes already set.
Head (CODE_02C88C): pose [$1602] chooses offset and OAM slot, head pose [$151C] chooses tile ($06,$0A,$0E,$0A,$06,$4B,$4B) and X-flip.
Pose 9 (splitting): head raised by ([$1540]-$20)>>5 and 1 pixel X shake.
Tile and flip tables for the head are at the start of this section.

ChuckBody2.name: Chuck body tiles and routine
summary: Tables: body tile 2 by pose, flip bits and sizes for tiles 1 and 2, OAM slot offset. Then the body routine (CODE_02CA27): two 16-bit-aligned tiles per pose.
Facing right uses table index pose + $1A (second half), plus X-flip $40.
Quirk: for facing right, the flip and size tables are indexed past their 26 entries and read into the next table.

ClappinChuckTiles.name: Chuck arm tiles for poses 6-7
summary: Raised hands tiles ($0C and $44). Routine CODE_02CA9D draws extra tiles by pose: poses 6-7 two hand tiles (second X-flipped), $12-$13 the tile pair at CODE_02CAFC, $14+ the held tile at CODE_02CB53.

ChuckGfxProp.name: Chuck extra tile pair (poses $12, $13)
summary: Draws two 8x8 tiles ($1C, $1D) side by side, 8 pixels above sprite Y, for the run poses $12 and $13. Properties by direction at the start.

s02CB53.name: Chuck held tile (poses $14-$19)
summary: Draws one 8x8 tile ($AD) beside the Chuck for poses $14-$19, if the Y offset for the pose is not 0.
The table is addressed as CODE_02CB2D+pose (X offsets) and CODE_02CB39+pose (Y offsets), which land on DATA_02CB41 for pose $14.

DigChuckTileDispX.name: Table: Diggin' Chuck shovel X offsets

DigChuckTileDispY.name: Table: Diggin' Chuck shovel Y offsets

DigChuckTileSize.name: Diggin' Chuck shovel graphics
summary: Tile sizes table, then CODE_02CBA1: for sprite $46 only, draws a shovel tile in the 4th OAM slot. Pose 5 uses shovel index 1; poses $0E+ use pose - $0E; other poses draw nothing.

WingedCageMain.name: Unused. Winged cage main
summary: Main routine of an unused sprite: a flying cage that keeps Mario inside a $90 x $60 box.
Draws the wings, sets BG3 scroll from the cage position, moves the cage by [$17BD]/[$17BC], moves Mario along when [$18B5] is set, then clamps Mario to the cage walls, ceiling and floor.
Standing on the floor sets [$1471] and [$18B5]. Returns early while a Mario animation is playing.
